law: Every planned building must be constructed from this registry — no agent invents positions.
Existing entities carry status 'existing' and MUST NOT move: their numbers are copied from the shipped code (baseline main @ 1ea39c2) and are load-bearing for the story, the E2E driver, and Save v1.
IDs are permanent. New entries append; never renumber.
Class A = fully enterable (interior required). Class B = ground-floor interior/service bay. Class C = exterior-only. Class D = backdrop mass/skyline.
Streets follow the existing 'sidewalk law': north Kestrel walking lane z 4–7.2 stays clear of solids; south walking lane z −7.2…−4.3 likewise.

researchBasis.grid: 1811 Commissioners' Plan reference proportions: avenues 100 ft (30 m), cross streets 60 ft (18 m), blocks 200 ft (61 m) N–S × 620–920 ft (189–280 m) E–W, 20 blocks per mile N–S (MCNY, thegreatestgrid.mcny.org). Alder Heights compresses these ~25% for game density; the ratio avenue > street is preserved.
researchBasis.typology: 25 × 100 ft (7.6 × 30 m) standard lots; brownstones 3–5 stories with high stoops; Old Law tenements on 25 ft lots; rooftop water tanks 5,000–10,000 gal on 4–6 story buildings (vitalcitynyc.org); NBA key 16 ft (4.9 m), FT line 15 ft from backboard, rim 10 ft (3.05 m) — the existing court already matches (key sidelines x 42.6/45.9 = 3.3 m apart, FT at z 7.2).

neighbourhood.name: ALDER HEIGHTS
neighbourhood.identity: A compact upper-Manhattan-flavored heights neighbourhood: one commercial cross street (Kestrel) between two avenues, brownstone rows north, pre-war walk-ups south, a pocket park and a community garden, the K subway under Juniper Avenue. October, golden hour, forever.
neighbourhood.canon: NEW-CANON NAMING: the shipped story (docs 08/30/33/34, content.ts) never names the neighbourhood or streets. These names are this milestone's design decision; they are flagged as the master plan's one act of naming authority and are reversible before construction phase W1 ships signage.
neighbourhood.cityContext: Fictional pocket of upper Manhattan between Harlem and Washington Heights (keeps GDD Regulars' homes coherent: Rosa's bodega canon, Darnell's Harlem courts a subway stop away, Priya's line runs under Juniper).
